description: Which catalog book a book in the reader's library is, and which of the reader's records in each book app are that book. Resenha writes these when it matches a reader's Popfeed books to BookHive's catalog, so Popfeed's and BookHive's own records are never changed to hold the match.

main.description: One per book. The record key is the book's BookHive ID (hiveId); a book with no match yet is keyed popfeed-<record key of its first listItem>.

hiveId.description: The book's BookHive ID. Absent when no match was found.

isbn13.description: The edition the reader's records name, when they name one.

bookhive.description: The reader's buzz.bookhive.book record for the book, when they have one.

reading.description: The reader's ink.resenha.reading record for the book, when that's where they keep it. A reading and the reader's Popfeed items named here are one book.

popfeed.description: The reader's social.popfeed.feed.listItem records for the book. A book can be on more than one list.

matchedBy.description: identifiers: an ISBN or Goodreads number agreed, or the item named its BookHive ID. search: title and author agreed. reader: chosen by the reader, and never changed automatically. none: no match yet.

book.description: The book in every key anyone uses: the link's own fields say which records are the book, this says which book.
